description:
Returns array of requested objects as fast as the engine allows it. The objects can be requested by object type and simulation kind.
{{Feature|informative|This command does not return terrain placed objects (except for terrain objects with lights, such as lamp posts, etc. which can be found in the slow entities collection). To get all terrain objects, use [[nearestTerrainObjects]] instead.}}
examples:
<sqf>
onEachFrame
{
	hintSilent str
	[
		count (63 allObjects 0),
		count (63 allObjects 1),
		count (63 allObjects 2),
		count (63 allObjects 3),
		count (63 allObjects 4),
		count (63 allObjects 5),
		count (63 allObjects 6)
	];
};
</sqf>
name: allObjects

Item.desc: type can be a combination of types according to bit flag operation (see [[getObjectType]])
Item.name: objectType

NumberEnum.desc: {{GVI|arma3|2.12|size= 0.75}} All types incl. nulls (nulls exist with 'objectCollection' 7 and 8)
Primary - normal object placed in Terrain Builder, part of landscape
Network - road placed in Terrain Builder, part of landscape
Slow (and very slow) entities: some houses, rubbles, street lamps, churches, etc
Fast entities: shots and other high precision entities
Out vehicles: objects that are not listed anywhere else, holders, etc

{{GVI|arma3|2.12|size= 0.75}} Sensor map: ordered triggers. When trigger is created it is added to this collection in the order of creation. When deleted it becomes null. Use 'objectType' -1 to include nulls

{{GVI|arma3|2.12|size= 0.75}} Vehicle map: ordered vehicles. When vehicle is created it is added to this collection in the order of creation. When deleted it becomes null. Use 'objectType' -1 to include nulls
{{GVI|arma3|2.18|size= 0.75}} Vehicles and crew: normal entities as in 1 as well as crew if an entity is a vehcile with crew.
{{GVI|arma3|2.22|size= 0.75}} Windlets: all objects of the type '#windlet'.
{{GVI|arma3|2.22|size= 0.75}} Active windlets: all objects of the type '#windlet' which are enabled.

Item.desc: type of the objects (will exact match return of [[typeOf]])
Item.name: objectType
